name: Rhinag
summary: Among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border, Rhinag waits, weakened by scorpids' venom. The Darkspear troll depends on passing travelers to find him a remedy in time.

sections.title: A Venomous Peril
sections.body: Rhinag shelters among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border after a Venomtail Scorpid stung him. The poison has left the Darkspear troll weak and isolated. He needs a venomtail antidote, and his survival depends on whether a passing traveler can find one before the toxins take their toll.

faq.answer: Rhinag is a Darkspear jungle troll traveler, stranded and weakened near Durotar's northwestern border after a scorpion's sting.
Rhinag rests among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border.
A Venomtail Scorpid stung Rhinag while he crossed Durotar. Its poison left him incapacitated, and he needs an antidote before it proves fatal.

angles.text: As a troll, you may see a kinsman brought low by Durotar's native wildlife. The Darkspear tribe faces many trials as it makes a home alongside the Horde.
